topics.purpose: Define language packs as keyed translations over canonical label identities, supporting the target UI languages without duplicating UI/domain structures.

semantics.pack_rule: Language pack maps label identity to localized presentation value.
semantics.identity_rule: Language pack never remaps canonical machine identities.
semantics.partial_rule: A pack may be incomplete while unlocked; missing entries remain explicit.
semantics.version_rule: Pack version/compatibility with label-set snapshot is explicit.
semantics.reuse_rule: Language packs are shared across Expose surfaces using the same label identities.
semantics.format_rule: Serialization format of the language pack is implementation detail/data representation.

invariants.rule: Localization changes human-facing labels and explanatory text only; canonical identities, commands and machine semantics remain language-independent.
